name: Sealed stomach water skin
description: A large animal's stomach, cleaned, dried and tied shut at both ends. Holds about 3 litres of water.
notes: A crafted container, so it has no loot tiers. Drawn full and tied off, the shape a player recognises. wax-cream stands in for dried gut skin and cord-olive for the ties. Holding about 3 L of liquid has no content field yet.

name: Lunchbox
description: A blue plastic lunchbox with snap latches and a carry handle on the lid.
notes: The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Craft kit box
description: A flat cardboard box for a children's building kit, its lid printed with coloured parts.
notes: Drawn empty with its lid on. The print on the lid is coloured blocks rather than a picture. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Propane tank (20 lb)
description: A white steel barbecue cylinder with a brass valve under a guard collar. Feeds a gas burner or grill.
notes: Holding gas charges and feeding a tool have no content field yet. The biogas tank shares the cylinder, differing only in what fills it. Drawn at a 6 mm grain so the valve and the collar openings read.

name: Ration meal bag
description: A heavy tan field ration bag, sealed at both ends. Holds a full meal in smaller pouches.
notes: The bag is a container for the meal's pouches; which pouches it holds has no content field yet, and the pocket grid is a placeholder. polymer-fde is the nearest finish to the tan laminate. The drawn brick reads as the bag pressed flat.

name: Ration entrée pouch
description: A flat tan foil pouch holding a ration's main course, sealed at both ends.
notes: The empty container that holds a ration's entrée; the food it holds has no content field yet. All five ration pouches share one shape at different sizes, each with its own printed panel colour so they read apart.

name: Ration side pouch
description: A small tan foil pouch holding a ration's side dish, sealed at both ends.
notes: The empty container for a ration's side dish; the food it holds has no content field yet. Its panel is olive so it reads apart from the entrée pouch.

name: Ration dessert pouch
description: A small tan foil pouch holding a ration's dessert, sealed at both ends.
notes: The empty container for a ration's dessert; the food it holds has no content field yet. Its panel is red.

name: Ration jam packet
description: A single-serve tan foil packet of jam from a field ration.
notes: The empty packet for a ration's jam; the jam it holds has no content field yet. At 6 mm thick the 2 mm printed panel is as thin as the voxel grain allows. Its panel is oxblood for fruit jam.

name: Ration spread packet
description: A single-serve tan foil packet of spread from a field ration.
notes: The empty packet for a ration's spread, the same size as the jam packet but with a brown panel so the two read apart; the spread it holds has no content field yet.

name: Plastic paint pail (1 gallon)
description: An empty white one-gallon plastic paint pail with a press-on lid and a wire handle.
notes: Holding about 4 L of liquid has no content field yet.

name: Metal paint can (1 gallon)
description: An empty one-gallon steel paint can with a pry-off lid and a wire bail. Can be set over a fire.
notes: cooking stands for a boiling quality. Holding about 4 L of liquid has no content field yet.

name: Pencil case
description: A soft navy fabric pouch with a zip along the top.
notes: paint-police-blue is the nearest finish to navy cloth; a navy or coloured cotton finish would read softer. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Petri dish
description: A shallow glass dish with a loose lid, used to grow cultures in a lab.
notes: cooking stands for a boiling quality. The tiles draw the glass opaque; it stays see-through in the game. The frosted patch on the lid is for writing on.

name: Pill organiser
description: A frosted plastic strip of seven compartments, one for each day, each under its own coloured lid.
notes: The drawn strip is small because a carried volume is not a measured box. The large pillbox shares the shape at a larger size. Holding pills by day has no content field yet; the pocket grid is a placeholder.
